title: Cooking Live Boston:
title_short: Cooking Live Boston · This dinner paid a mortgage
headline: A room in Boston cooked and gave so a family facing cancer keeps its home. The viewer should repeat: that dinner paid someone's mortgage.
story: Kristen, Paisley's mom, says it on stage: they paid our mortgage. Family Reach helped when nobody else could.
The problem is real: parents opt out of treatment because it is bankrupting the family. Ming Tsai calls it wrong; the system is broken.
Then the room gives: paddles go up for rent and mortgage help, and the night closes on the total raised. The event is context, not the subject.

Loops: L1 “Who paid whose mortgage?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:02 to 0:09, “We reached out to Family Reach for help and they came.” L2 “What did this room do about it?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the button, “helping us raise $1.25 million tonight.” Stakes: parents opting out of treatment because it is bankrupting the family.
do: Hook text “This dinner paid a mortgage.” on frame 1 over Kristen.
Cut it fast and phone-like for TikTok.
Paddles going up, 4 to 6 quick shots.
One number card on the button: $1.25 million raised.
Cut on “tonight” to the end card.
dont: Not about the chefs, the menu or the dishes. Not a timeline of the night.
No old Family Reach logo anywhere, including stage screens and banners in B-roll.
Don't use 76:49–76:51 (Kristen's husband). Needs Ansley's written approval.
Don't use 104:49–108:33 (a Family Reach video on the event screen).
No dish names, no recipe talk, no sponsor roll except the closing line.
